subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Automated Accessibility Testing
description: A quick, practical guide to Automated Accessibility Testing.

hook.text: A tool scans a website and finds 47 accessibility issues in seconds. Manual testing would have taken days.

buildup.text: Automated tools like axe, Lighthouse, and WAVE check for detectable WCAG violations programmatically.

discovery.text: Automated testing catches about 30% of accessibility issues: missing alt text, low contrast, missing labels.

twist.text: The remaining 70% requires human judgment: is the alt text meaningful? Is the tab order logical?

climax.text: Automated scans as a first pass filter the easy issues, freeing human testers for complex judgment calls.

punchline.text: Automate the detectable 30%. Then test the rest by hand.

quiz.question: What percentage of accessibility issues can automated tools detect?
